steps.question: Why is a candidate loss being decreasing insufficient to guarantee the stated minimum-average-loss requirement?
steps.answer_text: Decreasingness only says that assigning more probability to the outcome that occurred lowers that outcome's loss. It does not control the tradeoff among possible outcomes in expectation, so it does not guarantee that the average loss is minimized when the reported distribution q equals the true distribution p.
